examples.en: We must be mindful of the consequences of selfishness.
examples.zh: 我们一定要留意自私自利的后果。

examples.en: Mindful of the danger of tropical storms, I decided not to go out.
examples.zh: 想到热带风暴的危险，我决定不出门。

examples.en: If your definition of boredom is being quiet, mindful, and reflective, keep it up.
examples.zh: 如果你对无聊的定义是安静、专注和反思，那就将这一观点保持下去。
